meta.name: linkedin-formats
meta.description: Select the optimal LinkedIn content format and follow format-specific guidelines. Use when the user asks about carousels, video posts, text posts, polls, LinkedIn newsletters, format selection, reach multipliers, or content format specs. Do NOT use for post writing/structure (use storytelling) or posting schedule (use scheduling).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 选择 LinkedIn 内容格式，提升帖子表现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果发 LinkedIn 前纠结哪种格式效果更好
copy.tagline_en: Choose the best LinkedIn content format to boost post performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're unsure which LinkedIn format drives better engagement

howto.what: 当你询问LinkedIn内容格式时，Claude会推荐最佳格式（如轮播、文本、视频等），并给出该格式的具体优化建议，包括幻灯片数量、字符数等。
howto.when: 当你问及轮播、视频、文本帖子、投票、新闻通讯、格式选择或覆盖倍数等LinkedIn格式时触发。

say.text: 我想分享一个7步框架，哪种格式最好？
say.note: Claude会推荐轮播并给出9张幻灯片等建议。

say.text: 写一篇关于失败经历的文字帖子，有什么技巧？
say.note: Claude会建议文本帖子，并强调前210字钩子。

say.text: 如何推广我的博客文章到LinkedIn？
say.note: Claude会建议文字帖子总结要点+链接放评论区。

howto.what_en: When you ask about LinkedIn content formats, Claude recommends the optimal format (e.g., carousel, text, video) and gives format-specific guidelines like slide count, character limits, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you inquire about carousels, video posts, text posts, polls, newsletters, format selection, or reach multipliers on LinkedIn.

say_en.text: I want to share a 7-step framework. What format is best?
I'm writing a text post about a failure story. Any tips?
say_en.note: Claude suggests text post with a strong hook in first 210 chars.

say_en.text: How can I promote my blog article on LinkedIn?
say_en.note: Claude recommends text summary + link in first comment.
